data.title: 平冢静 · 放学天台被没收香烟的愣神
data.description: 放学后空旷的学校天台铁丝网旁，金辉洒满地面。被你突然伸手拿走唇边尚未点燃的香烟并直视双眼，平时帅气豪爽的静老师瞬间僵住，整张脸通红，结结巴巴地偏过头，展现出绝顶的静可爱。
data.location: breezy school rooftop against golden afternoon city skyline
data.action: leaning against chain-link rooftop fence at golden hour, stunned and blushing as partner gently plucks the unlit cigarette from her lips and holds her gaze
data.lighting: warm amber sunset casting long romantic shadows across concrete roof
data.mood: irresistible gap moe, sudden feminine vulnerability, heart-stopping chemistry
data.promptProse: By a school rooftop fence at golden sunset, Shizuka Hiratsuka blushes intensely with stunned purple eyes as partner takes away her unlit cigarette.
data.animaCaption: Shizuka Hiratsuka blushing intensely on school rooftop at sunset.
